final: SELECT `School Name`, `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` as ratio FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' ORDER BY CASE WHEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)` IS NULL OR `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NULL OR `Enrollment (K-12)` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` END DESC LIMIT 1
